visual_identity.core_mood: human dignity under oppressive power, vulnerable life protected, restrained hope
visual_identity.light: natural household and courtyard light, restrained shadows, no invented supernatural effects
visual_identity.spatial_character: human-scale ancient Egyptian and Near Eastern environments; institutions remain secondary to human encounters
visual_identity.human_tone: attentive, courageous, vulnerable, dignified; never sensational
visual_identity.scene_emphasis: human choices and care grounded in the current passage

continuity_rules: Use the current aliyah alone to choose people, objects and events.
Keep environments plausibly ancient without asserting precise archaeological identifications.
Express power and vulnerability through natural posture, scale and restrained gestures.
Keep clothing and practical household materials modest and historically plausible.
Landscape or architectural context must remain secondary to passage-supported human action.
forbid: past episode numbers or fixed scenes
events from later aliyot unless explicitly present in the current passage
